response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize this kingdom. Make it...futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
But, Your Majesty, this is a medieval kingdom. We can't just...vaporwave it.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Piper! I've seen the future. And the future is...glitchy.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

King Reginald is surrounded by his advisors, LORD THOMAS and LADY ISABELLA. They look on in confusion as the king begins to describe his vision.

KING REGINALD
I want the castle walls to be covered in neon lights. And the moat to be filled with...with...Jell-O.

LORD THOMAS
But, Your Majesty, that's not how it works.

KING REGINALD
Silence, Thomas! I'm the king, and I say it's going to be...vaporwave.

LADY ISABELLA
(skeptical)
And what about the knights, Your Majesty? They'll look ridiculous in their armor with neon lights and Jell-O.

KING REGINALD
Pish posh, Isabella! The knights will be...fashionable. They'll be...futuristic.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls are now covered in neon lights, pulsing and flashing in time with the kingdom's music. The moat is filled with Jell-O, and the knights are riding by on neon-colored steeds.

KING REGINALD
(to the knights)
Charge! Charge!

The knights charge forward, their armor glowing with neon lights. They ride past the Jell-O moat, leaving behind a trail of...of...glitchy, distorted images.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

King Reginald is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING REGINALD
(to the advisors)
I want this kingdom to be...the epitome of...proto-vaporwave.

LORD THOMAS
But, Your Majesty, this is madness.

KING REGINALD
Silence, Thomas! I'm the king, and I say it's going to be...futuristic.

LADY ISABELLA
(sarcastically)
Oh, joy. Because nothing says "futuristic" like a medieval kingdom with neon lights and Jell-O.

KING REGINALD
(smirking)
You just watch, Isabella. This kingdom will be...the talk of the...of the...galactic community.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The kingdom is now a sprawling, neon-lit metropolis, with Jell-O moats and glitchy, distorted images everywhere. The king rides by on a neon-colored steed, surrounded by his knights.

KING REGINALD
(to the knights)
Charge! Charge!

The knights charge forward, their armor glowing with neon lights. They ride past the Jell-O moat, leaving behind a trail of...of...glitchy, distorted images.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
